description: This file 'CMHAL.cpp' contains the implementation of the CMHAL class, which provides a set of methods to interact with hardware abstraction layer (HAL) for cable modems. It includes functions for initialization, configuration, status retrieval, and operational commands related to modem management such as downloading firmware, rebooting, fetching logs, and configuring network parameters.

classes.name: CMHAL
classes.description: The CMHAL class acts as a bridge between higher-level software components and the hardware abstraction layer (HAL) for cable modems. It manages initialization, configuration, status queries, and operational commands, encapsulating interactions with the underlying SSP HAL wrapper functions.
